# Everything before the first valid PLACE is discarded, and malformed lines
# never abort the run. Expected output: 2,2,SOUTH
MOVE                  # no robot yet
REPORT                # no robot yet
LEFT                  # no robot yet
PLACE 9,9,NORTH       # off the table -- not a valid PLACE
REPORT                # still no robot
FLY                   # unknown command
PLACE 1,1             # malformed: missing facing
PLACE one,two,NORTH   # malformed: non-numeric
PLACE 2,2,UPWARDS     # malformed: unknown direction
PLACE -1,0,NORTH      # off the table
place 2,2,south       # lowercase is accepted
REPORT
